slis.description: Fraction of queue managers whose native metrics endpoint is scraped successfully.
Fraction of queue managers reporting status RUNNING (2) to a client connected over a SVRCONN channel.
Highest current depth / MAXDEPTH across application queues. 1.0 means MQRC_Q_FULL for producers.
Age in seconds of the oldest message on each application queue (DIS QSTATUS MSGAGE, needs MONQ). The MQ equivalent of consumer lag in seconds.
Messages parked on the dead-letter queue. Any non-zero value is a delivery failure that needs a human.

Fraction of synthetic put→get round-trips that returned the matching payload within 5 s. `or vector(0)` on the good side is deliberate — when every attempt fails there is no result="ok" series at all.
99th-percentile put→get round-trip latency of the canary, client-observed.
Average recovery-log write latency. Persistent-message throughput is bounded by this number.

entries.title: HTTP service (OTel semconv)
entries.summary: Availability (non-5xx ratio), p99 request latency and in-flight saturation of an HTTP server instrumented with the OpenTelemetry SDK, in semconv v1.27.0 names.

sources: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions v1.27.0, "Semantic Conventions for HTTP Metrics" — http.server.request.duration (Histogram, s; attributes http.request.method, http.response.status_code, url.scheme, http.route, error.type) and http.server.active_requests (UpDownCounter, {request}); stable since v1.23.0 (vendor/observability-pack-spec/v1.2/spec.md pins otel.semconv "1.27.0")

OpenTelemetry specification, "Prometheus and OpenMetrics Compatibility" (Metrics Data Model) — the exposition naming rules applied above (dots to underscores, unit suffix, `_bucket` / `_count` / `_sum` for histograms, `_total` only on monotonic sums; attribute keys dot-to-underscore)
gaps: No live exposition of the semconv HTTP metrics is recorded in either repository; evidence is the semconv and the Prometheus-compatibility spec only.
A traffic (throughput) SLI is not declared; the per_route_traffic view shows it without an objective.

params.label: Service job label
params.description: The `job` label of the service's series (the resource's service.name after the OTLP → Prometheus translation).

params.label: Request-duration histogram base name
params.description: The exposition name of http.server.request.duration without the _bucket / _count suffix (drop `_seconds` when the exporter does not append units).

params.label: Health endpoint URL
params.description: The URL the blackbox probe hits to prove the service answers.

slis.description: Fraction of HTTP requests not answered with a 5xx status, from the request-duration histogram's _count series (semconv http.server.request.duration, label http_response_status_code).
99th-percentile server-side request duration in seconds, from the semconv http.server.request.duration histogram.
In-flight HTTP requests (semconv http.server.active_requests), against a ceiling of 100 per instance.
5xx responses per second (the same histogram _count series filtered to status 5xx), a domain SLI beside the ratio.

entries.title: Queue consumer (OTel semconv)
entries.summary: Consume success ratio, p99 processing duration, p99 receive-operation duration and processing error rate of a message consumer instrumented with the OpenTelemetry SDK, in semconv v1.27.0 names.

sources: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions v1.27.0, "Semantic Conventions for Messaging Metrics" — messaging.client.operation.duration (Histogram, s), messaging.client.consumed.messages (Counter, {message}), messaging.process.duration (Histogram, s); attributes messaging.system, messaging.destination.name, messaging.operation.type (enum — publish, create, receive, process, settle; the receive filter), messaging.consumer.group.name, error.type — messaging.operation.name is the system-specific operation name (poll, ack, send) and no SLI filters on it
OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions v1.27.0, "Semantic Conventions for Messaging Spans" — messaging.system as an open enum (the MQ evidence doc §7 uses "ibmmq" the same way)
OpenTelemetry specification, "Prometheus and OpenMetrics Compatibility" — the exposition naming rules applied above
gaps: No live exposition of the semconv messaging metrics is recorded in either repository.
No lag SLI — lag is product-specific (compose with the kafka or ibm-mq entry).
The messaging metrics were not stable at v1.27.0; a consumer instrumented with a later SDK may expose different names.

slis.description: Fraction of consumed messages whose operation carried no error.type (semconv messaging.client.consumed.messages; error.type is set only on failure, so an empty error_type label is a success).
99th-percentile per-message processing duration in seconds (semconv messaging.process.duration).

99th-percentile duration of the receive operation in seconds (semconv messaging.client.operation.duration filtered on messaging.operation.type = receive, the enum value; messaging.operation.name is the system-specific name and would select nothing).
Consumed messages per second whose operation carried an error.type.
